Photograph a woman wearing visible spring fashion layers, using the supplied photograph as the face and short black bob reference. She is fastening a fresh botanical print to a drying line inside a small riverside print workshop just after a spring shower. A newly opened sash window has sent a breath of air through the room: the bottom of the pale paper curls toward her while a gauze curtain lifts behind the taut line. At the shutter, her right thumb and index finger squeeze a small metal spring clip around the print's dry upper margin and the line; her left thumb and fingertips steady its dry lower corner beside her right hip. Her shoulders turn slightly toward the paper, both elbows bend naturally, and her weight rests on two feet set a little apart.
